description: Adds third-party domain-ownership tokens at the domain, one group per vendor with a fixed token prefix (Google, Facebook, Microsoft 365, Apple, Atlassian, DocuSign, Adobe, GlobalSign, OpenAI, Pinterest). Each token is added beside any existing TXT record (conflict mode None), because a domain often holds several tokens of one vendor. Only the groups passed via groupId are applied. Used by DoDomain (domain-connect-as-a-service) on behalf of its integrator applications; sharedProviderName is set so the consent screen can name the integrator beside DoDomain.
variableDescription: <vendor>Token = the token after that vendor's fixed prefix, for vendor = google (google-site-verification=), facebook (facebook-domain-verification=), microsoft (MS=), apple (apple-domain-verification=), atlassian (atlassian-domain-verification=), docusign (docusign=), adobe (adobe-idp-site-verification=), globalsign (globalsign-domain-verification=), openai (openai-domain-verification=), pinterest (pinterest-site-verification=); the group is the vendor name. Variables: googleToken, facebookToken, microsoftToken, appleToken, atlassianToken, docusignToken, adobeToken, globalsignToken, openaiToken, pinterestToken.
